q: -5 in 8-bit two's complement is...
why: Write 5 as 00000101, invert to 11111010, add 1 to get 11111011.

q: Adding 127 and 1 in 8-bit signed gives...
why: The true value 128 does not fit, so the bits wrap to -128.

q: Why is 0.1 stored with a small error?
why: Many decimals are repeating fractions in binary, so the nearest value is stored.

q: A AND B OR A AND NOT B simplifies to...
why: A(B + B') = A.

q: NOT(A AND B) equals...
why: De Morgan: the complement of an AND is the OR of the complements.

q: 12 V across 4 ohm gives a current of...
Three resistors in parallel have a total that is...
why: Each extra branch adds a path, so total resistance falls.

q: A load in parallel with the lower resistor of a divider...
why: The load reduces the lower resistance, so the output falls.

q: 32 address bits, 64 byte blocks, 128 sets: how many tag bits?
why: Offset 6 + index 7 = 13, so the tag is 32 - 13 = 19.

q: If 90% of a job is made 10 times faster the best overall speedup is about...
RAID 5 protects against...
why: RAID survives a disk failure; it is not a backup.

q: The fuse in a circuit mainly protects...
why: It must blow before the wire overheats, so it cannot exceed the wire's rating.

q: A healthy CAN bus measured at rest reads about...
why: Two 120 ohm terminators in parallel.

q: Why must you not rely on a diagram's wire colour key?
options: Colours differ between makers and even between diagrams
why: No universal code: use the vehicle's own wiring diagram.

q: Which bus suits a rear camera video stream?
why: Video needs tens to hundreds of megabits per second.

q: Before working near an airbag you should...
options: Follow the maker's disconnect and wait procedure
why: Stored energy can fire it; the procedure and wait time are mandatory.

q: Cells in series mainly add...
why: Series adds voltage; parallel adds capacity.

q: The slowest part sets the AC charge speed. A 7 kW wall box with a 11 kW on-board charger gives...
why: The wall box is the limit.

q: In vehicle standards, high voltage means above about...
why: Above 60 V DC is classed as high voltage and can be lethal.

q: What should a harness plan end with?
why: Calculations predict; measurements confirm.

q: Before adding a module that sends CAN messages you should...
why: More traffic can overload the bus.

q: A cache has free space but a new address still misses. The most likely reason is...
options: A conflict: other addresses already use the same set
Misses only happen when the cache is full
why: Each address maps to one set. If that set is full, a miss happens even though other sets are empty. More ways reduce this.

q: In the logic simulator, when does a flip-flop output change?
why: A flip-flop copies its input on the clock step and holds it otherwise.

q: A CAN signal has raw value 11290, factor 0.25 and offset 0. The value is...
why: Value = raw x factor + offset = 11290 x 0.25 = 2822.5.

q: A trouble code P0301 should lead you to...
options: Replace the spark plug on cylinder 1
Check the cylinder 1 misfire cause with live data and tests
why: A code names a condition. Causes include plug, coil, injector or compression, so confirm before replacing.
